svg.title: Law of leaky abstractions
svg.desc: A feed service loops over 50 photos and prints each author's name, which looks like reading a field. Under the ORM layer it sends 1 query for the photos and 1 per author, 51 in all, about 100 ms of waiting at 2 ms each, and cracks open in the layer. Adding select_related on author replaces them with one JOIN.
svg.text: photo.author looks like a field. The loop makes 51 trips to Postgres.
